title: Clean up what an archived change left behind
summary: Once a change is archived and merged on the default branch, its leftover worktrees, local branches and uncommitted copy in the main checkout are marked **Stale** — even with uncommitted files in them. **End session** then offers **Clean up leftovers**, and the change's detail offers **Clean up leftovers…**: one confirmation copies their uncommitted files under `~/.spec-control/branch-backups/` and removes them.
